method: User-visible Heeler controls on two assigned Simulators with previously trusted SSH Device Keys. The lab-only Rex inventory, terminal grid, repository and launch recorder supplied independent observations. Each PASS is one completed end-to-end action on its named Host. Interrupted acceptance rows retain their completed substeps.

limitations: Both devices reused their trusted Host entries. There was no repeated first-use Host key confirmation.
The half-width observation used one Heeler window on an iPadOS display. A second interactive app was not used.
The Claude process in the new worktree was the task-owned launch recorder. The foreground notification came from real Pi 1.5.2.
